doc: Current die contracts the fleet-viz element registry derives its element list from (tools/fleet_viz/die_contracts.py, registry-sync 2026-10-15). Die leads: when a contract revision lands, point the sources here at it and record replacements in 'retire' with the log/contract evidence. 'complete': true = every element of the design's target that is in no current contract is shown superseded (with these contracts as evidence); false = the contract does not yet enumerate the whole die, so unlisted rows keep their loop state and are flagged 'not in current contract'.
